description: Search TfL for a stop name or NaPTAN / SMS code and return compact stop matches. Cached 24h. For modes: ["bus"] this expands 490G… hubs so a street name returns boarding stops, not two raw search hits. Use the returned id with get_arrivals.

modes.description: Optional mode filter, for example ["tube"] or ["bus"].

query.description: Stop name or 5-digit bus stop code.

name: resolve_stop_id
